author: toketrain
body:
If there isn't a way to give your credits to other players, there definitely should be. On some servers you can /pay players your money. These are obviously not the kind of servers Avicus is, but still, if I were to leave at any time I'd wanna give my credits away to someone.
After all, they are ours to do whatever with after we earn them. :)
